coupons_code_format.name: coupons_code_format
coupons_code_format.value: "coupons"."code" = upper("coupons"."code") AND length("coupons"."code") BETWEEN 3 AND 32 AND "coupons"."code" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9-]*'

orders_online_contact.name: orders_online_contact
orders_online_contact.value: "orders"."channel" = 'COUNTER' OR "orders"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "orders"."guest_phone" IS NOT NULL
